name: Peter Pelissier
bio: Peter Pelissier was nominated for constable at the Citizens' Nominating Convention in October 1886. The paper listed him among the successful candidates in November 1886.
mentions: …ntz. For Justices of the Peace. G. G. Bond, A. T. Packard, C. F. Ellison, Howard Eaton. For Constables. Peter Pelissier, William Jones, Samuel Whitney, Charles Uderman. For County Seat. Medora.

…A. T. Packard, C. F. Ellison and Howard Eaton were nominated by acclamation as justices of the peace.  Peter Pelissier, Wm. Jones, Samuel Whitney and Chas. Uderman were nominated by acclamation as constables.  On motion of Willis Eaton, Medora was named as county seat.  Adjourned.
…ANTZ. For Justices of the Peace. G. G. BOND, F. D. FOSTER, C. F. ELLISON, HOWARD EATON. For Constables. PETER PELISSIER, WILLIAM JONES, SAMUEL WHITNEY, CHARLES UDERMAN. For County Seat. MEDORA.
